2607.16001.title: BayesPO: Bayesian Prompt Optimization via Parallel-Tempered Gradient-Guided Discrete MCMC
2607.16001.paper_summary: Prompt optimization adapts large language models (LLMs) without updating model parameters, but many automatic prompt optimizers remain heuristic search procedures over candidate instructions. This paper studies prompt optimization as Bayesian posterior sampling over discrete prompt tokens. We define a posterior distribution by combining a task likelihood term, which rewards prompts that explain input-output examples, with a language-model prior, which favors fluent instructions. This converts prompt optimization into an energy-based posterior sampling problem, for which gradients can be used to guide discrete Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) proposals over vocabulary tokens. We refer to our framework as BayesPO, short for Bayesian Prompt Optimization. In this paper, BayesPO is instantiated with Markov chain Monte Carlo: it uses a Metropolis-Hastings corrected Gibbs-with-Langevin (GwL) proposal and integrates parallel tempering for global exploration of rugged LLM-induced energy landscapes. The concrete sampler further adapts the GwL sampler to the practical constraints of non-weight-tied LLM embeddings. Experiments with Qwen2.5 models show that the sampler discovers semantically meaningful prompts on diagnostic tasks, that parallel tempering helps escape a local optimum in a poetry completion task, and that post-optimizing APE prompts on 24 instruction-induction subtasks improves average accuracy from 60.04% to 63.23%. The study also reveals two main limitations: energy minimization may overfit small optimization sets, and the current sampler remains computationally expensive. These findings position Bayesian prompt sampling as a principled post-optimization tool and point to a promising direction for probabilistic prompt optimization.
2607.16001.paper_summary_zh: 提示優化在不更新模型參數的情況下調整大型語言模型（LLMs），但許多自動提示優化器仍然是候選指令上的啟發式搜索程序。本文將提示優化研究為離散提示標記上的貝葉斯後驗取樣。我們通過結合任務似然項（該項獎勵解釋輸入輸出範例的提示）和語言模型先驗（該先驗偏好流暢的指令）來定義後驗分佈。這將提示優化轉換為一個基於能量的後驗取樣問題，對於該問題，可以使用梯度來指導離散的馬爾可夫鏈蒙特卡羅（MCMC）提議，遍歷詞彙標記。我們將我們的框架稱為BayesPO，即貝葉斯提示優化的簡稱。本文中，BayesPO 使用馬爾可夫鏈蒙特卡羅：它使用經過Metropolis-Hastings修正的Gibbs-with-Langevin（GwL）提議，並整合平行退火以全局探索崎嶇的LLM誘導能量景觀。具體的取樣器進一步將GwL取樣器調整為非權重綁定LLM嵌入的實際約束。對Qwen2.5模型的實驗顯示，該取樣器在診斷任務中發現了語義上有意義的提示，平行退火有助於在詩歌完成任務中逃脫局部最優解，並且在24個指令誘導子任務上後優化APE提示將平均準確率從60.04%提高到63.23%。研究還揭示了兩個主要限制：能量最小化可能會過擬合小的優化集，且當前的取樣器仍然計算成本高昂。這些發現將貝葉斯提示取樣定位為一種原則性的後優化工具，並指出了概率性提示優化的有希望的方向。
2607.16001.author: Junjie Zhou et.al.
